text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Environmental Public Health (Part IV Fees) Regulations 2019 and come into operation on 1 April 2019.

2. The fees specified in the second column of Part 1 of the Schedule are payable to the Singapore Food Agency in respect of licences under Part IV of the Act for the matters specified opposite in the first column.

3. The fees specified in the second column of Part 2 of the Schedule are payable to the Singapore Food Agency in respect of the matters in Part IV of the Act which are specified opposite in the first column.
4. The Environmental Public Health (Licence Fees) Regulations (Rg 4) are revoked.
